business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Business and MD&A sections
business_model.claim: Granite Ridge earns revenue from its interests in oil and natural gas production, which it holds through operated partnerships and traditional non-operated assets in six U.S. basins.
quotes: We derive our revenues from our interests in the sale of oil and natural gas production.
Granite Ridge is a scaled energy company which aims to provide shareholders with exposure similar to energy private equity through operated partnerships and traditional non-operated assets.

business_model.claim: In operated partnerships the company supplies most of the capital and keeps control of development, while a private operator runs the assets and earns an economic interest after return hurdles are met. Traditional non-operated assets are minority interests in wells that third-party operators propose, drill and operate.
quotes: Typically, we structure these transactions to have an economic interest in the wells that benefits the operator after certain return hurdles are met to incentivize and align the operator with our interest.

Our non-operated asset base is built by investing in minority interests which give us a right to participate on a proportionate basis alongside third-party operators who propose, drill, and operate the assets.

business_model.claim: The company does not sell its production directly. Operating partners market it to energy marketing companies, refineries and their affiliates. Oil is priced off spot oil markets and natural gas mostly on first-of-month index or daily spot prices.
quotes: We generally rely on our operating partners to market and sell our production.
Our oil production is expected to be sold at prices tied to the spot oil markets.
which operating partners market on our behalf to energy marketing companies, refineries, and their affiliates

quotes: We hold assets in the Permian (Delaware and Midland basins), Eagle Ford, Bakken, Haynesville, Denver-Julesburg (“DJ”) and Appalachian basins (collectively, our “Properties”).
